entries.title: Acts 20:1
segments: And after the uproar had ceased, calling the disciples and greeting [them], Paul left to go into Macedonia.

entries.title: Acts 20:2
segments: And passing through those parts, and exhorting them with much speech, he came into Greece.

entries.title: Acts 20:3
segments: And spending three months [there], there [being] a plot against him by the Jews, being about to sail into Syria, he proposed to return through Macedonia.

entries.title: Acts 20:4
segments: And Sopater of Berea accompanied him into Asia, and Aristarchus and Secundus of the Thessalonians, and Gaius of Derbe, and Timothy, and Tychicus and Trophimus as far as Asia.

entries.title: Acts 20:5
segments: Going before, these waited for us at Troas.

entries.title: Acts 20:6
segments: And after the days of Unleavened [Bread], we sailed away from Philippi and came to them at Troas [in] five days, where we stayed seven days.

entries.title: Acts 20:7
segments: And on the first of the week, the disciples having been assembled to break bread, being about to depart on the morrow, Paul reasoned to them. And he continued his speech until midnight.

entries.title: Acts 20:8
segments: And there were many lights in the upper room where they were assembled.

entries.title: Acts 20:9
segments: And a certain young man named Eutychus [was] sitting on the window sill, Paul reasoning for a longer time, being overborne by sleep, he fell down from the third floor, and was taken up dead.

entries.title: Acts 20:10
segments: And Paul went down and fell on him, and embracing [him] said, Do not be terrified, for his soul is in him.

entries.title: Acts 20:11
segments: And going up, and breaking bread, and tasting, and conversing over a long [time], until daybreak, he went out thus.

entries.title: Acts 20:12
segments: And they brought the young man alive, and were not a little comforted.

entries.title: Acts 20:13
segments: And going ahead onto the ship, we sailed to Assos, there intending to take in Paul; for so he had appointed, intending himself to go on foot.

entries.title: Acts 20:14
segments: And when he met with us at Assos, we took him in and came to Mitylene.

entries.title: Acts 20:15
segments: And we sailed from there and came the next [day] across from Chios. And the next [day] we arrived at Samos, and we stayed at Trogyllium. And the next [day] we came to Miletus.

entries.title: Acts 20:16
segments: For Paul had determined to sail past Ephesus, so that he might not lose time in Asia; for, if it were possible for him, he hastened to be at Jerusalem on the day of Pentecost.

entries.title: Acts 20:17
segments: And from Miletus he sent to Ephesus and called the elders of the church.

entries.title: Acts 20:18
segments: And when they had come to him, he said to them, You know how I was with you at all times, from [the] first day I arrived in Asia,

entries.title: Acts 20:19
segments: serving the Lord with all humility of mind, and many tears and temptations happening to me through the plots of the Jews;

entries.title: Acts 20:20
segments: [and] how I kept back nothing that was profitable, but have shown you and have taught you publicly, and from house to house,

entries.title: Acts 20:21
segments: testifying both to the Jews, and also to the Greeks, repentance toward God and faith toward our Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.title: Acts 20:22
segments: And now, behold, I am going bound by the Spirit to Jerusalem, not knowing the things that shall happen to me there,

entries.title: Acts 20:23
segments: except that the Holy Spirit witnesses in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions await me.

entries.title: Acts 20:24
segments: But none of these things move me, neither do I count my life dear to myself, so that I might finish my course with joy, and the ministry which I received from the Lord Jesus [Christ], to testify fully the gospel of the grace of God.

entries.title: Acts 20:25
segments: And now, behold, I know that you all will see my face no more, among whom I went proclaiming the kingdom of God.

entries.title: Acts 20:26
segments: Therefore I testify to you on this day that I [am] pure from the blood of all.

entries.title: Acts 20:27
segments: For I did not keep back from declaring to you all the counsel of God.

entries.title: Acts 20:28
segments: Therefore take heed to yourselves, and to all the flock over which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers, to feed the church of God which He has purchased with [His] own blood.

entries.title: Acts 20:29
segments: For I know this, that after my departure grievous wolves shall enter in among you, not sparing the flock.

entries.title: Acts 20:30
segments: Also men shall arise from your own selves, speaking perverse things in order to draw disciples away after them.

entries.title: Acts 20:31
segments: Therefore watch and remember that [for the time] of three years I did not cease to warn everyone night and day with tears.

entries.title: Acts 20:32
segments: And now, brothers, I commend you to God, and to the word of His grace, which is able to build you up and to give you an inheritance among all those who are sanctified.

entries.title: Acts 20:33
segments: I have coveted no man's silver or gold or apparel.

entries.title: Acts 20:34
segments: Yea, you yourselves know that these hands have ministered to my needs, and to those who were with me.

entries.title: Acts 20:35
segments: I have shown you all things, that working in this way we ought to help the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, that He Himself said, It is more blessed to give than to receive.

entries.title: Acts 20:36
segments: And saying these things, kneeling, he prayed with them all.

entries.title: Acts 20:37
segments: And there was much weeping of all, and falling on the neck of Paul, they ardently kissed him,

entries.title: Acts 20:38
segments: grieving most of all over the word which he had spoken, that they should see his face no more. And they went with him to the ship.
